# Localizer

> Localizer renders a command-line tool's own strings (help, options, messages, errors, prompts) in the user's language. It supports Go (Cobra) and Python (Typer, Click, argparse) CLIs. AI translations are kept in sync through pull requests by a hosted GitHub App or GitHub Action, and applied by a small runtime library with no network calls. Open-source runtime (NCSA license); the service serves public repositories.

The one line: Go `localizer.Localize(root, locales.FS)`; Python `localizer.localize(app, "yourcli.locales")`. Go module: github.com/DABH/localizer. PyPI package: localizer (import name localizer).

## Integration

- [AGENTS.md](https://locale.dev/AGENTS.md): step-by-step instructions for coding agents integrating Localizer into a CLI
- [Getting started](https://locale.dev/getting-started/): connect a repository, merge the onboarding pull request, try a language
- [Integration guide](https://locale.dev/guides/integration/): the one line per framework, the output helpers, what is extracted, limitations
- [Testing and QA](https://locale.dev/guides/testing/): pin tests to English, pseudo-localization, debug output

## Service

- [How it works](https://locale.dev/how-it-works/): from a push to a translated CLI
